triggers.notes: Available from the Lessons catalog and from explicit Learn more actions on proficiency badges or the proficiency picker.
Universal orientation lesson. It explains the proficiency coordinates used by Gef before language-specific curriculum paths diverge.

presentation.scroll_mode: Render all groups as one article-like vertical lesson surface in order.
presentation.pages_mode: Render each group as a learner page with Back/Next controls; level groups deliberately become separate pages so each level can use a large reusable level glyph.
presentation.teacher_presentation_mode: Use the same ordered group graph with classroom-sized controls; do not fork lesson content.

badge_deep_link_policy.entry: open the lesson at the tapped level group

presentation.manual_picker_policy: The quick self-report picker uses center 0 plus seven outward stops: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2, and Gef-only Fully fluent / Native. Pre-A1 remains an internal first-steps band between zero and A1 rather than a visible manual ring.
presentation.content_difficulty_policy: A level badge on a book describes reading demand unless another scope is explicitly stored.
presentation.learner_level_policy: Learner proficiency may retain separate Reading, Listening, Speaking, Writing, Interaction, and Mediation values. Current Gef product evidence may update Reading only; the other axes remain self-report-only until a real feature measures them.
presentation.next_policy: On lesson completion, the app resolves the next explicit item in the active language path; if none exists, it uses the next eligible universal catalog item, then returns to the originating context.
